bionic_pinned_sources.notice_mapping: All 3 source license headers uniquely match NDK sysroot NOTICE after removing comment decoration/whitespace; line offsets above.
bionic_pinned_sources.recipe: Pinned libc/Android.bp maps crtbegin_dynamic to crtbegin.c + crtbrand object (crtbrand.S); crtend_android to crtend.S; host-only linker_wrapper is excluded for Android target.

recipe_source_ranges.meaning: crtbegin_dynamic compiles arch-common/bionic/crtbegin.c and combines crtbrand. Host-specific linux_bionic linker_wrapper branch is excluded for Android target.

findings.compiler_rt_builtins: 64 -> 17 exact compiler-rt source paths, all same SPDX; lse.S is source to generated outline members; exact compiler-rt LICENSE.TXT embedded.
findings.libc++_static: 26 members -> 26 exact libcxx/src files, all SPDX Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception; exact LICENSE.TXT is embedded in the three LLVM NDK notice files.
findings.libc++abi: 16 -> 16 exact libcxxabi/src files, all same SPDX; exact LICENSE.TXT embedded.
findings.libunwind: 4 -> 4 exact libunwind/src files, all same SPDX; exact source LICENSE.TXT includes its legacy UIUC BSD-like/MIT section and is absent byte-for-byte from NDK NOTICE, NOTICE.toolchain, and collected prebuilt NOTICE.
open_gaps: Transitive included runtime headers/generated source inputs not audited here.
Hashes pin installed archive/object bytes and source metadata but do not prove bit-identical recompilation.

Check whether the UIUC/MIT license references to CREDITS.TXT require carrying the exact component credits files in a downstream distribution; NDK NOTICE includes the reference but not those credit lists. Pinned source contains compiler-rt/libcxx/libcxxabi CREDITS.TXT files; no libunwind/CREDITS.TXT exists at this revision.
findings.other_component_licenses: compiler-rt, libc++, libc++abi, libunwind LICENSE.TXT each carries legacy UIUC BSD-like/MIT dual-license text alongside LLVM Apache/exception terms. First 3 have exact matching NDK notice copies; libunwind does not.
findings.startup: crtbegin_dynamic.o source group: crtbegin.c and crtbrand.S; crtend_android.o: crtend.S; both archive/input hashes and source hashes included. Bionic BSD-style source notices occur in NDK sysroot NOTICE.
